objects.name: PORT SOVA
objects.description: Primary deep-water port and logistics hub for resupply of the division. Control of Port Sova is essential to sustaining operations beyond D+5.

objects.name: RIDGELINE AMBER
objects.description: East-west ridgeline offering observation across sectors 2 and 3. Loss of RIDGELINE AMBER exposes the divisional flank to direct fire and long-range observation.

objects.name: BRIDGE CLUSTER DELTA
objects.description: Three road bridges over the Sorva River within a 4km stretch. The only crossing sites capable of supporting MBT traffic in sector 4. Two of three bridges are in OPFOR-threatened area.
